title: Cooroora Trail

beo.heading: Cooroora Trail
paras: The Cooroora Trail is Trail 5 of the Noosa Trail Network, a set of signposted trails for walkers, horse riders and mountain bikers linking Pomona, Cooran, Kin Kin, Lake Macdonald and Cooroy. This 9 km stretch between Cooran and Pomona is largely in Tuchekoi National Park, around 390 hectares of bushland around Mt Cooroora, and gives wonderful views of Mt Cooroora and Mt Cooran. You will pass gates, picnic shelters and heritage signs along the way. Much of the network crosses private farmland, so please shut every gate behind you, do not skid, and give way to walkers and horses. After heavy rain the tracks become slippery, and some sections may be closed, so check before you ride. Trails like this are part of why Noosa is emerging as one of Australia's great winter cycling destinations.
